messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert: svc-ingress high 5xx rate detected (5m avg > 6%). Paging oncall. correlation_hint=abc123def456

Devon: oncall here, looking. seeing a spike in 503/504s at the gateway. starting timeline.

Maya: I'm seeing client errors too? Can you paste a sample request/trace id?

Devon: sample correlation id from recent 503s: abc123def456. grabbing kvlogs now.

jordan_sre: timeline so far: 02:10 UTC - p50 latency jumps, 02:12 - gateway 503 spike, 02:14 - first pager. impact: approx 12% of requests for model-inference route.

Devon: customer-facing: a couple of large tenants reported increased latency and retries. flagged sales and support.

kevin_eng: pinging eng-runtime. could this be an upstream (model-serving) OOM or retry storm?

eng-runtime: getting logs from pods in pool-rt-1. noticed heavy upstream connection resets and many 502 from egress-proxy to model-backend.

Maya: can you paste a compact log snippet?

eng-runtime: ```
[02:12:11] gateway request id=abc123def456 route=/v1/generate upstream=10.2.1.45:8080 status=502 conn_error="read reset" retries=3
[02:12:11] gateway request id=abc123def457 route=/v1/generate upstream=10.2.1.45:8080 status=502 conn_error="timeout" retries=2
[02:13:05] gateway request id=abc123def460 route=/v1/generate upstream=10.2.1.47:8080 status=503 queue_wait_ms=120
```

Devon: that matches kvlog: lots of "retries=3" entries. possible retry loop amplifying load.

jordan_sre: Hypothesis 1: backend model nodes overloaded and returning 502/timeout -> gateway retries multiply load -> global queue/backpressure -> 503s at gateway. Hypothesis 2: egress-proxy misconfiguration dropping keepalives causing connection resets.

kevin_eng: mitigation attempt 1: reduced gateway retry count from 3->1 for route /v1/generate (hotfix in-progress). deploying policy change now.

Devon: command run: `kubectl apply -f gateway-retry-policy-reduce.yaml` — rolling through canaries.

ops-lead: +1 for reducing retries. also scale up model pool-rt-1 by 30% to relieve pressure.

eng-runtime: scaling pool-rt-1 replicas 6->8. watching.

Maya: can someone dump the connection stats for egress-proxy? `netstat -an | grep TIME_WAIT` or proxy metrics.

eng-runtime: metrics: egress_connection_retries spike from 10/m to 180/m between 02:11-02:13. tcp_time_waits increased. looks like many short-lived connections.

Devon: mitigation update: after retry reduction and scale up, 02:18 UTC error rate dropped to ~2.1%. customer reports improving.

jordan_sre: saved timeline: 02:10 lat p50 rises; 02:12 gateway 502/503 spike; 02:13 retries amplify; 02:15 retry-policy patch; 02:16 scale-up; 02:18 partial recovery.

kevin_eng: temporary rollback plan if symptoms recur: 1) route traffic away from pool-rt-1 using smart routing 2) fallback to smaller/quantized model variant to reduce backend CPU.

Maya: asking infra to grab kube logs for pod with request id abc123def456: `kubectl logs pod/rt-45 -c inference | grep abc123def456`

eng-runtime: pod logs show repeated GC pressure around that time and worker threads saturating. snippet: ```
[02:11:58] worker-7 gc_pause_ms=210 cpu_util=98% inflight=64
[02:12:02] worker-3 alloc_failed OOM? retrying request
```

Devon: tagging this thread for full RCA. immediate owner: eng-runtime (kevin + team) for root cause and postmortem.

ops-lead: customer impact summary for execs: ~15 minutes of elevated errors impacting 3 enterprise tenants, ~1% request drop for smaller tenants due to retries. No data loss. Next: publish incident note and runbook actions.

jordan_sre: action items tracked in-thread: [A] collect full kvlog bundle (eng-runtime) [B] confirm retry policy changes effected (devon) [C] analyze GC/oom traces on model nodes (eng-runtime) [D] add circuit-breaker on gateway for model pool (product+eng).

Maya: please paste links to traces/dashboards. Datadog trace: https://dd/redwood/trace/abc123def456 (private)

Devon: created incident report ticket INC-2026-324 and uploaded timeline + kvlogs. assigning to kevin_eng.

kevin_eng: will follow up with RCA PR in 48h. initial notes: probable combination of backend GC-induced latency and aggressive gateway retries leading to backpressure. looking into persistent keepalive tuning.

jordan_sre: closing on-call handoff: leaving notes in pagerduty and marking as acknowledged. if we see a re-spike, page SRE again.

Devon: thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. If error rate > 3% for 5m, page SRE.
